name: Exp_MAOscillatorHist
summary: This EA trades based on the MAOscillatorHist custom indicator, which is a moving average oscillator histogram. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward from negative territory and sell positions when it turns downward from positive territory, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MAOscillatorHist自定义指标进行交易，该指标是移动平均线振荡器直方图。当直方图从负值区域向上反转时开多仓，从正值区域向下反转时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双移动平均线振荡器直方图的方向变化来捕捉动量转换。入场条件：当直方图值上升（Ind[2]>Ind[1]）且前值为负（Ind[1]<Ind[0]）时开多仓；当直方图值下降（Ind[2]<Ind[1]）且前值为正（Ind[1]>Ind[0]）时开空仓。出场条件：通过反向信号平仓——直方图下降时平多仓，直方图上升时平空仓，同时设有固定的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的保证金或固定手数的资金管理方式。振荡器使用两种可配置的平滑方法（支持SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA）和多种 Applied_price 类型，具有较高的灵活性。策略在新K线形成时计算信号，避免同一根K线内重复交易，信号延迟通过SignalBar参数控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on directional changes in a dual moving average oscillator histogram to capture momentum shifts. Entry conditions: buy when the histogram rises (Ind[2]>Ind[1]) and the prior value is negative (Ind[1]<Ind[0]); sell when the histogram falls (Ind[2]<Ind[1]) and the prior value is positive (Ind[1]>Ind[0]). Exit conditions: close positions on opposite signals — close longs when the histogram declines and close shorts when the histogram rises, with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin/balance, or fixed lot size. The oscillator uses two configurable smoothing methods (supporting SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) and multiple applied price types, offering high flexibility. The strategy calculates signals only on new bar formation to avoid repeated trading within the same bar, with signal delay controlled by the SignalBar parameter.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Margin usage ratio for lot size calculation

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/扣除亏损后/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode (free margin/balance/net loss/fixed lots)

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 应用于计算的价格类型

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号确认使用的K线索引

pros: 支持10种平滑算法和9种价格类型，策略灵活性极高
新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易
多模式资金管理（固定手数、余额比例等），适应不同风险偏好
买卖开平仓可独立开关，便于只做单向交易或仅信号提示
固定止损止盈设置，每笔交易风险可控
pros_en: Supports 10 smoothing algorithms and 9 applied price types, offering extremely high strategy flexibility
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated position opening within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Multi-mode money management (fixed lot, balance ratio, etc.) adapts to different risk preferences
Buy/sell open and close can be independently toggled, convenient for unidirectional trading or signal-only mode
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings ensure controllable risk per trade
cons: 依赖自定义指标文件MAOscillatorHist，缺少该文件则EA无法运行
没有点差过滤机制，高点差环境下可能出现滑点过大或虚假信号
止损1000点/止盈2000点设置过大，对某些品种可能不合适且缺乏动态调整
没有检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓
指标句柄创建失败仅打印日志但不提供更详细的错误诊断信息
cons_en: Depends on custom indicator file MAOscillatorHist; EA cannot run without it
No spread filter mechanism; high spread environments may cause excessive slippage or false signals
Stop-loss 1000 points / take-profit 2000 points are excessively large for some instruments and lack dynamic adjustment
No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially causing duplicate position opening
Indicator handle creation failure only prints a log message without detailed error diagnostics
improvements: 增加点差过滤和最大持仓检查，避免高点差和重复开仓
添加动态止损止盈机制（如ATR倍数），替代固定点数以适应不同品种波动性
增加指标数据有效性检查，确保CopyBuffer返回值正确处理所有边界情况
improvements_en: Add spread filter and maximum position check to avoid high-spread entries and duplicate positions
Implement dynamic stop-loss/take-profit (e.g., ATR multiples) instead of fixed points to adapt to different instrument volatilities
Add indicator data validity checks to ensure CopyBuffer return values are properly handled for all edge cases

risk_points: 没有检查同方向已有持仓，可能重复开仓导致风险敞口过大
固定止损止盈点数不适应所有品种，小波动品种可能止损过宽、大波动品种可能止损过窄
缺少点差过滤，在流动性差或新闻时段可能以不利价格成交
risk_points_en: No check for existing same-direction positions; duplicate openings may cause excessive risk exposure
Fixed stop-loss/take-profit points don't suit all instruments — too wide for low-volatility, too narrow for high-volatility pairs
No spread filter; orders may fill at unfavorable prices during low liquidity or news events
